tools.name: docker_containers
tools.description: Containers on this Mac's Docker engine, running first, each with its image, state, status, ports and Compose project and service.

query.description: Words in the name or image.

state.description: running, exited, paused, restarting, created or dead; several joined by commas.

tools.name: docker_container
tools.description: One container: its exit code and error, health checks, restarts, command, mounts, networks, ports and env variable names, never their values.

tools.name: docker_logs
tools.description: A container's latest log lines with their time and stream. Read it to find why a container crashed or what a request did.

tail.description: The last this many lines. Default 200, at most 5000.

sinceSecs.description: Only lines from the last this many seconds.

grep.description: Only lines with these words, ignoring case.

tools.name: docker_stats
tools.description: CPU, memory against its limit, network and disk I/O and process count of each running container, measured now.

ids.description: Only these containers, by name or id.

tools.name: docker_act
tools.description: Start, stop, restart, pause, unpause or kill a container, and read it after. Only when the person asked for it.

tools.name: docker_stacks
tools.description: Compose stacks on this engine with the folder and files each came from, and each service's containers and state.

tools.name: docker_stack_act
tools.description: Start, stop or restart every container of a Compose stack, or take it down, keeping its volumes. Only when the person asked for it.

tools.name: docker_images
tools.description: Images on this engine, newest first, with their tags, size, age and how many containers were made from each.

tools.name: docker_disk
tools.description: How much disk images, containers, volumes and the build cache use, and how much removing the unused ones would free.
